```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")

joined <- open_dataset("data/history.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  left_join(markets, by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
         prediction_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
         days_to_resolution = as.numeric(as.Date(resolved_at) - date),
         horizon = case_when(
           days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "90+ days",
           days_to_resolution > 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
           days_to_resolution > 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
           days_to_resolution >= 1 ~ "1 to 7 days",
           days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
         ),
         horizon = factor(horizon,
                          levels = c("90+ days", "30 to 90 days",
                                     "7 to 30 days", "1 to 7 days",
                                     "Final day")))

groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  rename(time_bucket = horizon) |>
  summarize(mean_error = mean(prediction_error, na.rm = TRUE),
            snapshots = n(),
            .by = time_bucket) |>
  arrange(time_bucket)

accuracy |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "#9b6fc9", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#6a3fa0", size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days until the market resolved",
    y = "Mean absolute error",
    caption = "Source: Manifold Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0,
                 fill = "#b49ad8", color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecasts pile up near 0% and 100%",
    subtitle = "Crowd probability of YES on each market's resolution day",
    x = "Forecast probability of YES",
    y = "Number of markets",
    caption = "Source: Manifold Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(bin = pmin(floor(probability * 10), 9) / 10) |>
  summarize(actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
            n = n(),
            .by = bin) |>
  arrange(bin)

calibration |>
  ggplot(aes(x = bin, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
              linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(color = "#9b6fc9", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = "#6a3fa0", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecasts are reliable at the extremes but noisy in the middle",
    subtitle = "Share of markets resolving YES, by final-day forecast. Dashed line = perfect calibration",
    x = "Predicted probability of YES",
    y = "Actual share resolving YES",
    size = "Markets",
    caption = "Source: Manifold Markets"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
